{{Quote|So be ready for anything&hellip;That beauty who comes up and asks you to dance might just be an Imperial spy. That drink she bought you could be laced with a sleep inducer.|[[Cohden K'Reye]]|<ref name="WHSV">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref>}}
A '''sleep inducer''' was a drug capable of rendering someone unconscious. [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] [[operative]]s were known to slip them into a target's drink to knock them out, then transport them to an interrogation facility.<ref name="WHSV" />
